lesson.title: Common-factor extraction
lesson.objective: Identify and extract the greatest common factor from algebraic expressions.
lesson.explanation: Find the largest factor shared by all terms. Divide every term by that factor and write the remaining expression in brackets.
lesson.workedExample:
Factorise 8x² + 12x.
The greatest shared number is 4 and the shared variable is x.
So the GCF is 4x.
8x² + 12x = 4x(2x + 3).
lesson.summary: You can now identify a common factor. Assigned practice checks whether you can apply the step independently.

terms.gcfDefinition: Greatest common factor shared by every term in an expression.
terms.factorisationDefinition: Writing an expression as a product of factors.
